title: Models know word order only because we inject it
body: Pure attention is order-blind, a bag-of-words operation, so transformers add position information, originally sine waves of many frequencies, later rotations of the query and key vectors (RoPE). Without it, 'dog bites man' and 'man bites dog' are identical input. Word order in these models is a deliberate graft, not an emergent property.
source_hint: Vaswani et al. (2017); Su et al., RoPE (2021)
